nazwa_en: Faculty of Theology, University of Szczecin
opis: Profil importów WT (v50). Plany WT (Teologia, Nauki o rodzinie) to SKANY bez tekstu: szkic robi AI z obrazu strony – z pliku wgranego tutaj albo odczyt zapisany w plan-bm (odczyty/wt/, scripts/us/wt-pdf.mjs → kolejka nauka_import_szkic_automat).

plan.polecenie:
Each item is ONE class in the weekly timetable of one year of study. The page is a scanned image of one table: weekday blocks as rows (PONIEDZIAŁEK … PIĄTEK, rotated label on the left), time slots in the left column ("8:15 9:45", "10:00 11:30", "11:45 13:15", …; a last row without times holds afternoon classes with their own red time), and one column per year of study ("ROK 1" … "ROK 5" for Teologia; "Nauki o rodzinie I st. rok 1" … "II st. rok 2").
grupa = the year group code given in the task (e.g. TEO1, NOR2); one task = one column. tydzien = oba. d = weekday: 0 Monday … 4 Friday (a red "PIĄTEK 8:15-9:45" inside a Thursday cell means Friday).
od/do = a red time written in the cell ("15:30-17:00", "od 9:45" = start 9:45, end of the slots covered) or the slots the cell covers (a cell spanning two slots = 10:00–13:15).
A column split into two sub-columns = two classes for the same year (usually on different dates), pg = "".
pl = subject without the bracket; k from the bracket: [wykład] = W, [ćwiczenia]/[ćw.] = CW, [laboratorium] = LAB; languages (Język …), Emisja głosu, Wychowanie fizyczne = CW; Wykład ogólnouczelniany = W; no bracket = X.
p = teacher as printed ("Ks. dr hab. …"). r = the blue room number as "s. 202"; another building as printed: "s. 107 ACKJ, ul. Wawrzyniaka 15".
Dates in blue with Roman months: "12 X 19 X 26 X 9 XI" = those days, "od 16 XI" = every week from then on, "w pierwszej/drugiej połowie semestru" = first/second half of the weeks; daty as YYYY-MM-DD (October 2026 – January 2027), [] when every week. Hours per date ("8 X (2h)") and footnotes [1]–[5] from the second page go to n.
Skip classes whose dates are still to be set (footnote "Terminy i godziny … zostaną ustalone", "w dniach ustalonych"). en = "", g = "", n = notes or "".
